exam.title: Administering Windows Server Hybrid Core Infrastructure
exam.study_prerequisites: Several years of Windows Server experience plus practical AD DS, Group Policy, PowerShell, Hyper-V, DNS, DHCP, SMB/storage, networking, Azure VM, Microsoft Entra hybrid identity, Azure Arc, and monitoring knowledge.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Deploy and manage Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) in on-premises and cloud environments
Manage Windows Servers and workloads in a hybrid environment
Implement and manage an on-premises and hybrid networking infrastructure

review.notes: Four objective groups and the documented portions of the virtual-machine group are substantively mapped to identity, management, compute, network, and data paths, three scenarios, nine labs, and 24 checks. Azure Network Adapter and Extended Network have implementation, validation, troubleshooting, and cleanup coverage. The September 7 best-effort pass registered Microsoft transport and lab evidence plus qualified Ubuntu, Red Hat-family, SUSE/openSUSE, Oracle Linux, systemd, libvirt, Microsoft Press, and expert sources. The source-validation outcome remains blocked because no current Microsoft end-to-end SSH Direct implementation contract or compatibility matrix was found; the guide teaches the provisional model and a versioned validation plan without presenting it as universal support. All 77 cited URLs are cataloged: 73 reachable, four training pages access-blocked, and none missing.

sources.title: Make your own integration services with Hyper-V sockets
sources.notes: Confirms the non-network Hyper-V socket substrate, Linux AF_VSOCK mapping, host families, LIS dependency, and kernel options; not an SSH Direct support contract.

sources.title: MSLab
sources.notes: Microsoft-owned experimental lab evidence for Linux provisioning through hv_socket; not production support documentation.

sources.title: MSLab Debian 11 SSH Direct Packer template
sources.notes: Concrete older Debian 11 composition using hv_sock and OpenSSH socket activation on vsock port 22; distribution and version specific.

sources.title: Windows Server 2019 Inside Out sample
sources.notes: Historical hvc.exe SSH example tied to Windows Server 2019-era material; corroboration, not a current support matrix.

sources.title: Hyper-V Socket Support for the built-in hvc.exe SSH command
sources.notes: Community-authored open issue with useful diagnostic tracing; neither product documentation nor a support commitment.

sources.title: HVC - SSH Direct for Linux VMs on Hyper-V
sources.notes: Named-expert preview-era explanation and field comments; retain its age and configuration-sensitive behavior.

sources.title: Ubuntu hv_sock OpenSSH socket-activation regression
sources.notes: Current distribution bug evidence comparing Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04 behavior; useful failure evidence, not a universal recipe or support statement.

sources.title: Virtualizing Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7 on Hyper-V
sources.notes: Historical RHEL Hyper-V integration evidence; predates the SSH Direct objective and does not document hvc.exe or VSOCK SSH activation.

sources.title: RHEL 8.5 release notes: socat AF_VSOCK support
sources.notes: Confirms AF_VSOCK listen/connect support in RHEL's socat package; a diagnostic building block, not end-to-end Hyper-V SSH Direct proof.

sources.title: RHEL 10.2 AF_VSOCK namespace parameters
sources.notes: Current RHEL AF_VSOCK namespace behavior; does not establish Hyper-V transport packaging, OpenSSH configuration, or hvc.exe interoperability.

sources.title: CentOS Stream 9 kernel modules include hv_sock
sources.notes: Third-party package-index evidence for one CentOS Stream build; verify the installed signed package and do not treat CentOS Stream as a RHEL support statement.

sources.title: Fedora 44 OpenSSH server package inventory
sources.notes: Fedora-owned inventory of OpenSSH socket units; does not prove a VSOCK listener, Hyper-V transport, or RHEL-equivalent packaging.

sources.title: Fedora 44 SELinux policy SSHD VSOCK rules
sources.notes: Fedora policy evidence for SSHD VSOCK sockets; not a RHEL support statement or an hvc.exe validation.

sources.title: SUSE 16 kernel package hv_sock maintenance
sources.notes: Current SUSE kernel maintenance evidence for hv_sock; does not identify a supported SLES SSH Direct matrix or install a guest listener.

sources.title: openSUSE Factory OpenSSH VSOCK listener packaging change
sources.notes: Archived Factory package change for a libvirt-oriented SSHD VSOCK listener; Hyper-V and SLES applicability remain unverified.

sources.title: SUSE Package Hub virtme SSH-over-VSOCK history
sources.notes: SUSE package evidence for SSH-over-VSOCK as a maintained pattern; targets virtme/KVM rather than Hyper-V hvc.exe.

sources.title: Oracle Linux VSOCK interface configuration
sources.notes: Current generic Oracle Linux KVM VSOCK configuration; does not establish Oracle Linux as a Hyper-V SSH Direct guest, and UEK/RHCK remain separate tests.

sources.title: Linux Integration Services 4.1 Hyper-V sockets guide
sources.notes: Historical hv_sock evidence for named enterprise distributions and kernels; old, does not configure SSH, and cannot establish current support.

sources.title: systemd VM interface
sources.notes: Maintained upstream evidence that systemd 256+ can bind SSH to AF_VSOCK port 22; distribution enablement and Hyper-V hvc.exe interoperability remain unproven.

sources.title: Libvirt SSH proxy
sources.notes: Maintained upstream VSOCK SSH implementation guidance for QEMU/libvirt; a cross-distribution model, not Hyper-V SSH Direct support evidence.

findings.resolution: Replaced gMSA-only citation; added a narrowly scoped service migration exercise.

findings.title: SMB defaults depend on client/server direction and edition
findings.evidence: Server 2025 requires outbound signing; supported Windows 11 24H2 business editions require both directions.
findings.recommendation: Added NAS diagnosis, read-only inspection commands and version boundary.
findings.resolution: Added NAS diagnosis, read-only inspection commands and version boundary.

findings.resolution: Added scoped node-pool lifecycle guidance without implying Windows Server OS retirement.

findings.title: Conditional Access statements conflict
findings.evidence: The article both excludes Conditional Access for the Windows Server extension and describes enforcement; no unambiguous reconciliation found.
findings.recommendation: Retain a visible support limitation and seek authoritative clarification.

findings.title: SSH Direct still lacks current end-to-end support evidence
findings.evidence: Microsoft transport and historical lab evidence do not establish a current supported host/guest procedure. The exact CentOS package-index URL is now missing.
findings.recommendation: Retain a visible support limitation and seek authoritative clarification.
